stories.title: Unusual metal oxide shows signs of magnetism under lattice strain in ultrathin layers
stories.desc: Ruthenium dioxide (RuO2) is a metal oxide that commonly serves as an important metallic conductor, quantum material and industrial electrocatalyst. stories.title: Quantum computer completes verified task beyond practical reach of classical simulations
stories.desc: IBM and researchers from the University of Chicago announced a demonstration in quantum computing that meets the fundamental criteria for "quantum advantage"—the point where quantum computers can be confirmed to have outperformed classical computers on trusted computations.
